verdict.rationale: Microsoft documents an official Agents Toolkit CLI for Teams. It covers creating, previewing, provisioning, deploying, validating, packaging and publishing agents and apps, and the probe confirms the CLI documentation exists. Its scope is the developer app lifecycle, not operating Teams itself (messages, channels, teams), so it delivers only part of a general official CLI. Missing for 10: CLI commands for core Teams operations such as messaging and team/channel management, AI-native or agent-oriented CLI affordances, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Agents Toolkit CLI offers the same features as the IDE extensions.
Validate, package, and publish your agent or application using CLI commands.
Provision necessary cloud resources and deploy your application to Azure.
